Package com.sciometrics.android.slapshot.api.capture

Interface IReviewRequestBuilder

All Known Implementing Classes:
ReviewRequestBuilder
public interface IReviewRequestBuilder
The request builder object for reviewing a ICapturedModality from an identity. Used in calls to ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.runReviewCapturedModality(int, IReviewRequest, ICaptureStatusCallback)

    • setIsMutable

      IReviewRequestBuilder setIsMutable(boolean isMutable)
      sets whether the IReviewRequest is mutable (default, false). If false, nothing in the capture.

      isMutable - whether the IReviewRequest is mutable (default, false)

    • setShowImagesInReview

      IReviewRequestBuilder setShowImagesInReview(boolean showImagesInReview)
      sets whether an actual photo of the captured biometric will be shown in the review (true), or just a graphic representing the results (false) (default, false). This setting is only effective for certain biometrics (e.g. slap captures)
      Parameters:
      showImagesInReview - whether an actual photo of the captured biometric will be shown in the review (default, false)
      Returns:
      builder
